cohort: 124 gestational surrogates with 494 pregnancies (352 singleton live births)
finding: Neonates born from commissioned embryos carried by gestational surrogates have increased adverse perinatal outcomes compared with singletons conceived spontaneously and carried by the same woman.
mod_finding: The study found that surrogate pregnancies, compared to spontaneous pregnancies in the same women, had higher rates of cesarean section.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery reported
